sentences.text:
Applicant :- Avnish Kumar Singh
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Anita Singh,G.A.,Kumari Poonam Rajpoot,Nirmla Kumari,Prem Babu  Counsel for Opposite Party :-
Piyush Dubey Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the first informant and perused the record.

This application has been moved on behalf of applicant- Avnish Kumar Singh with the prayer to release him on bail in Case Crime No.406 of 2022, under Sections 323, 307 and 506 I.P.C., Police Station- Tajganj, District- Agra.
It is argued by the learned counsel for the applicant that the firearm injury, which is said to be sustained by the first informant in the supplementary report is found to be simple.
The applicant is the husband of the victim/ first informant.
Regarding criminal history of one case being Case Crime No.181 of 2022, under Sections 493, 498A, 341, 323 313, 504, 506/34 of IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act, the applicant is on bail.
The bail order is appended at page-70 of the paper book.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 04.03.2024, hence, the prayer for bail is made.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the first informant opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the applicant is the husband of the first informant.
From the perusal of the record, it is found that the applicant is the husband of the first informant.
The applicant is said to have inflicted firearm injuries to the first informant.
The injuries, as per supplementary report, are found to be simple in nature.
There is criminal history of only one case against the applicant, wherein the applicant is on bail.
The bail order is appended with the paper book.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 04.03.2024.

Perusing the record, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, the nature of allegations,
arguments advanced by the learned counsel for the parties and without expressing any opinion on the merit of the case, I find it to be a fit case for granting bail to the applicant.
The bail application is allowed.

Let the applicant- Avnish Kumar Singh, who is involved in aforesaid crime be released on bail on his furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions:-
1. The applicant will attend and co-operate the trial proceedings pending before the court concerned on the dates fixed after release.
2. The applicant will not tamper with the witnesses.
3. The applicant will not indulge in any illegal activities during the bail period.

The identity, status and residential proof of sureties will be verified by the court concerned and in case of breach of any of the above conditions, the trial court shall be at liberty to cancel the bail and send the applicant to prison.

It is clarified that the observations, if any, made in this order are strictly confined to the disposal of this bail application and must not be construed to have any reflection on the ultimate merits of the case.

Order Date :- 15.5.2024 Radhika  Avnish Kumar Singh vs State Of U.P. on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/89462726/
